summary_notes.region: United Kingdom (alphabetically Ace Of Lanes through Crystal Palace Amusements)
summary_notes.method: Full ZIv UK API pull (728 venues) matched to all 115 shard rows; official pages fetched for major chains and high-value rhythm venues.
summary_notes.no_closed_confirmed: ZIv UK closed field empty for all shard venues. No official permanent-closure proof found for any of the 115 during this pass.
summary_notes.stale_risk: Many seaside/holiday/bowling rows have ZIv ages of 2-11 years; absence of proof of closure is not proof of open dance cabs.
summary_notes.not_individually_rechecked_online: Most seaside amusements, Butlins sub-venues, and bowling alleys with only 'other' games were covered via ZIv age/machine snapshot only, not per-venue official pages.
summary_notes.other_uk_rhythm_not_in_this_shard: FreePlayCity, Funland London, Playback Bristol, NQ64 chain, Pixel Bar Manchester, Escape to Freight Island, Heart of Gaming Croydon, etc. appear in ZIv UK but outside A-C name range of this shard.
